newsitem.title: UK: Euro veg oils end touch lower despite tender news.
newsitem.headline: Euro veg oils end touch lower despite tender news.

text.p: European vegetable oils closed a touch lower despite news that Egypt had purchased palm oils albeit without buying the full amount tendered for.

Egypt's state-owned Holding Company for Food Industries said it bought on Wednesday, 15,000 tonnes of palm oil at $534.5 per tonne and 7,000 tonnes of palm stearin at $416 per tonne for delivery in August. It had tendered 10,000 tonnes of stearin.
At the close in Europe, the palm oil sector was unchanged to $5 lower and was awaiting Malaysian June 1-25 export data from cargo surveyor SGS (M) due for release on Thursday.
Palm oil trade during the afternoon was confined to Aug/Sep olein at $550.
Soy oil finished weaker, pressured by early losses on Chicago soyoil futures. At the end it stood 0.25 to 0.75 guilders per 100 kilos down. Rape oil was unchanged from Tuesday's close.
Soy oil changed hands for 105 and 102 guilders for Aug/Oct and Nov/Jan respectively, while rape oil fetched 103.25 guilders for Aug/Oct.
Coconut oil closed $2.50 either side of Tuesday's close but only managed one trade, on Jul/Aug at $642.50. --Stephen Grainger +44 171 542 8074.
